chunks: When we are dead and turned to dust, this returning (to life) is most far-fetched.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'that is a distant return' in Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In Surah Qaf, the polytheists of Mecca challenge the concept of bodily resurrection by citing the physical reality of decomposition into dust, viewing revival as an impossibility. From a Shia scholarly perspective, this verse underscores the divine power to recreate the original form, affirming that death is not an end but a transition to a new creation. It serves as a foundational argument for the certainty of the Hereafter, countering materialistic skepticism with the promise of divine reassembly.
